verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at help.puzzle.io (HTTP 200) with a structured index of help-center articles, and the cited help articles are served as .md URLs, so an agent can be pointed at machine-readable docs. Coverage is limited to end-user help-center content: the docs-md root probe returned 404 and there is no OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: agent-oriented developer/API docs (no OpenAPI spec found), evidence of an llms-full.txt or broader docs coverage, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
